text:
Olivia (PMM): Draft ready — longform launch post for Redwood Optimize attached. Need a quick pass from legal + benchmarks + final CTA. Target publish Wed EOD. Draft link: https://docs.google.com/REDWOOD_OPTIMIZE_DRAFT :eyes:

Liam (Design): Skimmed. Tighten the first two paragraphs, they wander a bit. Also need 2 quote slots (CTO + customer). Hero image still TBD — will draft variants.

Maya (Growth): Benchmarks — can you add a short table of perf vs baseline? i.e., tokens/sec and latency p50/p95. I can pull analytics this afternoon. Also want an embedded webinar registration CTA. :wave:

Sam (Sales): @Olivia can we make CTA route to demo scheduling for enterprise-looking leads? sales prefers demo-first for qualified traffic.

Ava (Legal): On it. I'll review any claims/data points today. Please flag any quantified claims with source links or test ids.

Olivia (PMM): Thanks. Plan: A/B CTA (demo vs ebook). Sam — can you confirm routing rules? Maya — can you set up HubSpot mapping for the two flows?

Maya (Growth): Yup. I'll create two leadflows: `webinar-demo` and `ebook-nurture`. Ping me with the HubSpot form IDs and UTM params. I'll also add tracking for landing-to-webinar conversions.

Liam (Design): Quick design note: hero should visually call out "Dedicated capacity" not just a cloud icon. Uploading 3 variants by 2pm.

deploy-bot: Reminder — publishing queue opens at 09:00 PDT Wed. To avoid queue hold, mark the doc `ready_for_publish` and attach final assets.

Olivia (PMM): Ava, any red flags? If not, I'll route to exec for quick quote pulls.

Ava (Legal): No major legal red flags so far. Small wording change: replace "3x faster" with "up to 3x faster" and include test link/comment. I'll add an inline comment in the doc.

Sam (Sales): Confirmed — demo-first is fine. Routing rules: if company_size > 50 seats => AE queue, else ebook nurture. Also prefer meeting links that auto-fill company field.

Olivia (PMM): :thumbsup: OK — timeline: internal QA by Tue EOD, final assets in by Wed 9am, publish Wed EOD. Flag blockers here or DM. Thanks all!
